ui.headline:
Your MAERYO journey
begins with a sip
ui.intro: Take your time to explore the aromas and discover the flavors of MAERYO.
ui.footer: Take your time. Discover your taste.

welcome.title: Welcome to MAERYO
welcome.summary: A few things to know before your experience begins.

steps.title: Find your guide
steps.body: Scan the QR code at your activity table to open the guide.

steps.title: Follow your host
steps.body: Please follow the instructions provided by our staff during the activity.

cautions: Please ask a staff member if you have any questions.

tasting.title: MAERYO tasting guide
tasting.summary: Explore the aromas and flavors in your glass, one step at a time.

steps.title: Check your drink
steps.body: Ask our staff about the drink and its ingredients before tasting.

steps.title: Explore the aroma
steps.body: Bring the glass closer and take a moment to enjoy the aroma.

steps.title: Take a small sip
steps.body: Taste a small sip and notice the flavors that linger.

cautions: If you have allergies or questions about ingredients, check with our staff before tasting.
Choose whether and how much to taste based on your circumstances.
Please do not taste alcohol if you plan to drive.
